cards.name: Sword Arm of Dragon
cards.description: With a body covered in sword-like thorns, nothing dares stand in the way of this monster when it changes.

cards.name: Two-headed King Rex
cards.description: An unusual and rarely seen two headed dragon.

cards.name: Mammoth Graveyard
cards.description: A mammoth that protects the gravesite of its pack. It's absolutely merciless when facing graverobbers.

cards.name: Megazowler
cards.description: Nothing stands in the way of this spike-covered dinosaur.

cards.name: Uraby
cards.description: Fast on its feet, this dinosaur rips enemies to shreds with its sharp claws.

cards.name: Crawling Dragon #2
cards.description: A powerful dragon with teeth that can grind almost anything to dust.

cards.name: Tomozaurus
cards.description: A deceivingly small creature that is so vicious it attacks both friend and foe without discretion.

cards.name: Two-mouth Darkruler
cards.description: A Dinosaur with two crushing jaws. Stores electricity in its horn and releases high voltage bolts from the back mouth on its head.

cards.name: Pragtical
cards.description: A very dangerous monster with spikes on its head and tail.

cards.name: Bracchio-raidus
cards.description: A colossal dinosaur that stomps on anything that wanders into its path.

cards.name: Anthrosaurus
cards.description: Man-like dinosaur lacking in strength but with a high I.Q.

cards.name: Trakadon
cards.description: A tiger-striped dragon that is often seen racing across the wasteland with tremendous speed.

cards.name: Little D
cards.description: A very ferocious monster spawned from a T-Rex.
